findings.title: API Gateway stage without access logging
findings.description: A stage without an access_log_settings block leaves no audit trail of API invocations, hampering incident response and anomaly detection.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: API Gateway stage without X-Ray tracing
findings.description: An aws_api_gateway_stage with xray_tracing_enabled unset or false (the provider default) emits no X-Ray traces, losing distributed visibility into API requests. Enable X-Ray tracing on the stage.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: API Gateway stage without a client certificate
findings.description: An aws_api_gateway_stage without client_certificate_id cannot present a client certificate to backend integrations, so backends cannot authenticate that calls genuinely come from API Gateway. Generate a client certificate and attach it to the stage when the backend supports mutual authentication.

evidence.actual: absent (no client certificate for backend auth)
evidence.expected: client_certificate_id referencing an API Gateway client certificate

findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: API Gateway deployment without a description
findings.description: An aws_api_gateway_deployment without a description is indistinguishable from other deployments in history, slowing rollback decisions during incidents. Describe what each deployment changes.

evidence.expected: a description of what the deployment changes

findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
